---
title: "Prime Table Example"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
PRIME_COUNT <- 1000
ROWS_PER_PAGE <- 50
COLUMNS_PER_PAGE <- 4
COLUMN_WIDTH <- 10

generate_primes <- function(count) {
  primes <- c()
  if (count == 0) return(primes)
  primes <- c(primes, 2)
  candidate <- 3
  while (length(primes) < count) {
    is_prime <- TRUE
    for (p in primes) {
      if (p > candidate %/% p) break
      if (candidate %% p == 0) {
        is_prime <- FALSE
        break
      }
    }
    if (is_prime) primes <- c(primes, candidate)
    candidate <- candidate + 2
  }
  primes
}

print_table <- function(primes) {
  page_number <- 1
  page_offset <- 0
  while (page_offset < length(primes)) {
    cat(sprintf("The First %d Prime Numbers --- Page %d\n\n", length(primes), page_number))
    for (row in 0:(ROWS_PER_PAGE - 1)) {
      line <- ""
      for (column in 0:(COLUMNS_PER_PAGE - 1)) {
        index <- page_offset + row + column * ROWS_PER_PAGE + 1
        if (index <= length(primes)) {
          line <- paste0(line, sprintf("%*d", COLUMN_WIDTH, primes[index]))
        }
      }
      cat(line, "\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\n")
    page_number <- page_number + 1
    page_offset <- page_offset + ROWS_PER_PAGE * COLUMNS_PER_PAGE
  }
}

print_table(generate_primes(PRIME_COUNT))
```
